P3-DASH-001.detail: Normal Dashboard and the inspected Stat Card/Line Chart configurations expose no current-versus-prior comparison control or comparative result. The Phase 3 comparison workflow cannot be selected.

P3-PROD-001.detail: The live product form/type options contain no serialized inventory mode or per-unit serial-number controls. Basic variants and per-product custom text fields are not unit-identity tracking.

P3-PROD-003.detail: Native bundle recipe entry refused 0, -1 and 1.5 with inline validation. Fresh reads preserved the valid 2A+3B recipe after every invalid attempt. The valid two-kit cash control then consumed exactly 4A/6B in the verified invoice branch; fixture stock was recovered and products archived.

P3-PROD-005.detail: Category management exposes no field/schema definition control. The separate Custom Fields tab configures only an individual product and does not define or inherit category attributes.

P3-PROD-007.detail: With sale-branch components at zero and another QA branch at A=10/B=8, the normal POS cash attempt returned HTTP 422 pos.insufficient_stock. All branch balances stayed unchanged. The same-branch stocked two-kit positive control passed separately; all owned balances were recovered before archiving.

P3-ADJ-001.detail: The native voucher saved two owned products (+5 and +7) under one persisted audit record. Zero was refused inline; an insufficient-stock multi-item request and nonexistent product/variant IDs returned 422 without changing either balance. Fixture balances were restored to zero and both products archived. Cross-tenant IDs were not probed.

P3-TRF-001.detail: No manifest, delivery-slip, PDF/download or print action is exposed at any inspected reachable transfer stage.

P3-TRF-002.detail: The reachable transfer states provide no damage/shortage/discrepancy input, received-quantity adjustment or dispute action; receipt is a whole-transfer completion action.

P3-COUNT-001.detail: The list offers Start a count only. Its form has Branch and Notes; opening a count always freezes the full branch. No category or scheduling control is available.

P3-COUNT-002.detail: Only per-row numeric inputs are present; there is no barcode target/mode, and the emulated SKU plus Enter leaves every counted value unchanged.

P3-EXP-003.detail: Expired rows expose Delete batch only; no disposal/write-off request, supervisor approval or linked disposal ledger is available.

P3-EXP-004.detail: Native batch entry refused 0 and -1 with inline errors and no POST. The same form then saved a positive quantity of 2; a fresh list contained exactly one matching batch with initial_quantity=2. The owned batch was deleted and canonical product stock restored. Separate FIFO/FEFO-compatible allocation, opposed receipt/expiry ordering and lot exhaustion controls also passed.

P3-GRN-001.detail: The receiving form exposes accepted/rejected quantities and rejection reason only; no manufacturer lot or expiry capture input is available.

P3-LOOKUP-001.detail: Server-search pickers found newly created products by lower-case SKU in batch creation, Invoice and Quotation; both billing customer pickers found a later-created active contact beyond the old initial page. Inactive contacts were excluded and stale selected contacts were refused by both save endpoints. MVP-LOOKUP-001 is the same capability. This does not certify every search-ranking or pagination boundary.

P3-POS-001.detail: Checkout remains on the payment dialog while offline; no sale confirmation/receipt or IndexedDB database is created to retain a durable queued sale. Online mutation processing may remain paused until reconnection.

P3-POS-002.detail: No loyalty/points balance or redemption control is exposed in the POS cart; no loyalty programme appears in the served POS implementation.

P3-QUEUE-001.detail: The editor provides priority, estimated time, ready date and internal notes only. No assignment selector or table/bay input is present.

P3-QUEUE-002.detail: The card menu offers Edit / Add Note and Cancel Order only; there is no ticket/print action.

P3-QUEUE-003.detail: The native Processing product was saved with processing enabled and its first normal POS cash sale created the owned queue entry, without API repair or a second sale. Live transitions to in_progress, ready and delivered persisted and were reflected by polling. Assignment and thermal-ticket generation remain separate failing tickets; drag-and-drop and cross-user timing are not certified.

P3-INV-001.detail: Recurring contract billing cannot be configured. No corresponding workflow is available on the inspected live forms/settings.

P3-INV-002.detail: Invoice editor has no per-invoice currency or recorded exchange rate. No corresponding workflow is available on the inspected live forms/settings.

P3-CN-002.detail: A standalone native Save as Draft retained status=draft and changed no stock. Issuing Billing correction changed stock by 0; issuing Product return added exactly 1. Repeated issue requests returned 422 and did not restock again. Fresh note/stock reads and stock restoration passed. No refund or external payment was sent.

P3-PO-001.detail: Only manual PO creation and low-stock reporting are available; no automatic reorder policy/schedule or generation workflow is exposed.

P3-PO-002.detail: The inspected PO states expose status changes, print and receive controls but no direct supplier email action or transmission status.

P3-AP-001.detail: The form has an optional PO reference plus aggregate subtotal/tax. It has no goods-receipt/line matching controls; the list has no match status or reconciliation action.

P3-SUP-001.detail: Export downloads supplier profile/contact/credit-term fields. No dated ledger/balance statement or separate statement export action is exposed.

P3-SUP-002.detail: An owned product-to-supplier mapping persisted supplier_sku, preferred status and lead time. The native supplier catalogue displayed the supplier SKU and found the product by that exact supplier SKU; the mapping was detached and the owned product archived.

P3-CUST-001.detail: The account form has Individual/Business type and status, but no group/tier selector. Settings > Customers provides custom fields only, with no pricing-tier rules.

P3-CUST-002.detail: Native create persisted creditEnabled=true, limit 25 and future expiry; native edit preserved them, rejected zero while credit was enabled, then persisted limit 50 and the changed expiry after a fresh read. The owned contact was retained inactive. Over-limit/expired-credit checkout enforcement is not certified by this configuration check.

P3-REP-001.detail: The report exposes product revenue, cost, profit and gross margin only; there is no net-margin/operating-expense breakdown.

P3-REP-002.detail: Customer receivables aging exists, but no supplier/payables aging report appears in the catalogue or Bills controls.

P3-RPT-001.detail: The form offers a predefined report type, branch and dates only; no dimension/metric or custom query filter editor is present.

P3-RPT-002.detail: An All-branches report with empty dates returned object filters, stayed visible after a fresh list read and ran successfully through Run now. A dated filtered template also persisted and ran; owned templates were deleted. Scheduled email delivery remains blocked without a controlled inbox. The separate visual query-builder gap remains P3-RPT-001.

P3-DOC-001.detail: The available workflow is preset/form configuration and preview; no editable canvas, element palette or draggable layout elements are exposed.

P3-FONT-001.detail: Native Settings upload accepted Regular/Italic TTF files as multipart bodies, persisted both after reload and downloaded byte-identical files (SHA-256 matched fixtures). Invalid TXT was rejected, and the separate management-case font was deleted. MVP-FONT-001 is the same upload defect. Using these fonts in billing remains blocked by new RET-FONT-001; selected-font rendering is not passed.

P3-RBAC-001.detail: No create/add custom role action is present; the Permissions view exposes no editable per-entity matrix.

P3-SEC-001.detail: A valid own-session refresh retained one session row. Targeted revocation returned success, removed that row and made both access and refresh return 401; anonymous access also returned 401. Own logout removed its row. Other sessions/authentication factors were preserved. This verifies live behavior rather than direct Redis configuration.

P3-API-002.detail: The stale unsupported-API-key notices are corrected, and session-free authentication/rotation/global read-only deny/write-enabled allow/revocation controls passed. The full methods/paths/schemas/resource reference for Products, Inventory, Invoices, Orders and Customers remains unavailable. Per-resource restricted scopes are not certified.

P3-WEB-001.detail: The live catalogue offers invoice.created, credit_note.created, quotation.created, payment.received. Missing required event names: order.created, stock.low, invoice.paid.

P3-HW-001.detail: The live page explicitly states label printing (Zebra ZPL) is not implemented and no label-generation action is exposed.

P3-BACKUP-001.detail: Native Export JSON returned 201 and created export job 1. The job completed; its own Download JSON action returned a valid 1,119,898-byte JSON file with generated_at/company_id/data and a QA marker. SHA-256 d8cb37ea699c8734f306395985a6a86d48b1de3f49fea98b6beaae66a17cfe55. This verifies job/file functionality, not exhaustive export completeness or restore. Fake toast-only buttons no longer establish a completed export; automated platform backup scheduling remains a separate failure.

P3-BACKUP-002.detail: No backup schedule, retention/storage management or execution history is exposed.

P3-HELP-001.detail: Search/FAQ expansion works, but the catalogue contains no video guide, video player or linked video tutorial.

MVP-FONT-002.detail: Two font-capable product Text definitions survived native create, fresh read, native edit/save and another fresh read; both Invoice and Quotation exposed usable corresponding text inputs. This closes product-definition storage only. Their entered billing values are lost separately under new RET-FONT-002.

MVP-CUST-001.detail: Active positive controls and persisted deactivation were exercised. Fresh Invoice and Quotation searches excluded the inactive owned contact. A separate native form selected the contact while active, deactivated it on another page, then received a customer-related HTTP 422 on Save as Draft for both document types. Owned contacts were retained inactive.

P2-DOC-004.detail: Classic Invoice, Quotation and Credit Note retained exact #17675e borders and rendered brand text #2e766e against actual #13191b at 3.3256:1, exceeding the ticket minimum 3:1 and developer target 3.1. The readable #15b8a6 control stayed unchanged at 7.1359:1. Template settings were restored after each check; this is not a general accessibility audit.

RET-FONT-001.detail: All four inspected selectors (two fields on Invoice and two on Quotation) offered only Default. Settings fonts 9 (QARETESTFontmwo8nflsRegular) and 10 (QARETESTFontmwo8nflsItalic) were absent despite successful native upload, fresh-list persistence and byte-identical downloads. Product 232 / QA-P3-FONTSERVIC-mwo8oo7b retained both font-capable definitions.

finding.title: Uploaded Settings fonts are unavailable in billing custom-text font selectors
steps: In Settings > Advanced, upload the bundled Vera.ttf and VeraIt.ttf as distinct Regular/Italic TTF fonts; reload and download each to verify persistence and exact SHA-256.
Create a Service with two Text custom fields (QA Engraving and QA Signature), enabling font support on both; save, reopen, save and verify a fresh product read.
Create an Invoice, find that product using the normal server-search picker and enter distinct text in both fields.
Open each field font selector and inspect the available options for the uploaded Regular/Italic fonts.
Repeat both field-selector checks on a new Quotation using the same product.
finding.expected: The uploaded tenant fonts are offered and selectable for each customer-facing custom-text field.
finding.actual: All four inspected selectors (two fields on Invoice and two on Quotation) offered only Default. Settings fonts 9 (QARETESTFontmwo8nflsRegular) and 10 (QARETESTFontmwo8nflsItalic) were absent despite successful native upload, fresh-list persistence and byte-identical downloads. Product 232 / QA-P3-FONTSERVIC-mwo8oo7b retained both font-capable definitions.
finding.comment: Upload and product-definition fixes passed. No font option was injected and no legacy localStorage font list was seeded (both billing checks observed null). A mismatch between the legacy font cache and server catalogue is a diagnostic hypothesis, not a verified backend cause. Populate both billing selectors from the tenant font catalogue and verify in a fresh session. Selected-font web/PDF output remains blocked before selection; Default controls do not prove an incorrect-font renderer defect. Fonts 9/10 and draft documents are retained for reproduction; the owned service is archived.
finding.environment: Production https://nexstock.stylotech.mu/app; Nexstock QA Company; Windows/Chromium/Playwright 1.62.1; 1920 x 1080; 20 November 2026.
finding.test: MVP-FONT-002 P3-FONT-001 P3-LOOKUP-001 custom text and independently selected fonts on saved Invoice Quotation and native PDFs

RET-FONT-002.detail: Both native POST requests included the two exact values in items[0].customFields. Both returned 201, but the response and fresh detail GET returned items[0].customFields=[]. Invoice 298 / INV-DJY67K and Quotation 40 / QUO-DP3RO0 both omitted the entered text from their customer-facing web view and native one-page PDFs. PDF extraction and visual review agreed. Product definitions remained persisted, so this is distinct from the corrected MVP-FONT-002 product-storage defect.

finding.title: Invoice and Quotation discard submitted customer custom text and omit it from web/PDF output
steps: Create/reopen the same Service with persisted QA Engraving and QA Signature Text definitions (font support enabled).
Add it to a new Invoice through the normal product picker and enter QAREGMWO8NFLS Emile & Co and QAITALICMWO8NFLS Personalised gift in the two fields.
Leave the available Default font selected; click Save as Draft and capture the native POST request and 201 response.
Reload the exact Invoice and inspect its fresh item data and customer-facing web document; export its native PDF.
Repeat the same native flow for a Quotation and inspect the fresh saved record, web document and native PDF.
finding.expected: Both entered text values survive save/reload and appear on the customer-facing web document and native PDF.
finding.actual: Both native POST requests included the two exact values in items[0].customFields. Both returned 201, but the response and fresh detail GET returned items[0].customFields=[]. Invoice 298 / INV-DJY67K and Quotation 40 / QUO-DP3RO0 both omitted the entered text from their customer-facing web view and native one-page PDFs. PDF extraction and visual review agreed. Product definitions remained persisted, so this is distinct from the corrected MVP-FONT-002 product-storage defect.
finding.comment: Default-font controls isolate text persistence from RET-FONT-001. Fix retention/serialization of billing item custom fields and render the saved text in both document types; then rerun Default controls and independent per-field selected-font browser/PDF checks. Do not close this merely because the editor displays the text before saving. Native draft documents were retained; no customer delivery occurred. Backend storage versus resource serialization is not directly visible from this repository.
finding.environment: Production https://nexstock.stylotech.mu/app; Nexstock QA Company; Windows/Chromium/Playwright 1.62.1; 1920 x 1080; 20 November 2026.
finding.test: MVP-FONT-002 P3-FONT-001 P3-LOOKUP-001 custom text and independently selected fonts on saved Invoice Quotation and native PDFs

limits: Physical printers, label output, scanners and cash drawer checks remain skipped at the user's request; software controls and document generation are distinguished from device operation.

No controlled QA email/SMS inbox or webhook receiver is available. External delivery, signatures/retries and scheduled report delivery are not certified; no external destination or live email schedule is created.
TOTP enrollment, backup-code replay and recovery login remain blocked without an isolated activated account. The shared primary owner's authentication factors are preserved.
Valid own-tenant IDs and nonexistent-ID controls can be tested. Cross-tenant enforcement is not certified without a second authorized disposable tenant.
A missing user workflow is a confirmed availability failure. Its downstream calculations, validation, delivery or persistence cannot be certified merely by inspecting the unavailable controls.
Credit configuration persistence is distinguished from over-limit or expired-credit checkout enforcement. The latter is not certified by the configuration ticket alone.
JSON export job/file behavior is distinguished from full data completeness, database restoration and automated platform backup execution; no production restore is attempted.
This campaign uses Windows/Chromium/Playwright at 1920 x 1080. It is not a fresh full cross-browser, mobile or complete Phase 1/2/3 acceptance campaign.

Font-upload verification covers the bundled Regular/Italic TTF fixtures and invalid TXT rejection. Other font formats and independent selected-font browser/PDF rendering are not certified: uploaded fonts are absent from both billing selectors. Default-font text controls also fail independently.
automationCorrections: Corrected the local Playwright browser-cache path and ran the authorized QA browser outside the restricted network sandbox. Browser startup/DNS failures were infrastructure attempts, not application defects.

Updated the stock-adjustment adapter for its deployed search combobox, multiple rows and signed text quantity fields; superseded failures from native-select/spinbutton assumptions are not application tickets.
Updated entity selection to use the deployed server-search controls and actual server responses, including lower-case SKU searches. No missing option is injected.

Updated quantity checks to observe inline rejection without waiting for the old erroneous request. Removed a redundant no-op recipe Save after fresh reads had already proved the valid recipe unchanged.
Added bounded retries for a transient ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED during read-only page navigation. No business mutation is automatically replayed; the interrupted scenario is rerun after stock recovery.

Expanded confirmation checks for credit issue/duplicate issue, session refresh/revocation/logout, credit-setting round-trips, unfiltered report runs, actual native JSON export output and per-text font rendering.

Corrected two cleanup/assertion adapters: inventory search inputs are checked by their value, and offline recovery reopens the verified QA workspace after leaving the offline page. Both affected cases were rerun; their superseded adapter failures are excluded.

Scoped asynchronous picker searchboxes using the trigger's aria-controls relationship; closing customer and opening product popovers can temporarily expose two searchboxes. The stale-customer Invoice/Quotation check passed on rerun.
Corrected the font inspection callback to receive the DOM element and test values separately. The prior callback error is superseded by the November 20 confirmation run.
Waited for the actual saved template response and Classic letterhead before measuring dark-mode styles; the prior Modern fallback measurement was superseded by both passing contrast controls.
fixtureSummary: Final November 20 live audit passed: all 70 ledger-owned catalogue fixtures are archived, none remain active, every owned archived branch balance is zero, and the canonical product matches its captured all-branch baseline.

Owned expiry lots, temporary API keys, saved-report templates and QAP3Font management fixtures are absent. The current retest stock-count draft is cancelled; stock/transfer recovery ledgers and template restoration are verified.

Original MVP font IDs 1 and 2 are preserved. Four QARETESTFont diagnostic fonts (IDs 8, 7, 10, 9) are deliberately retained: 7/8 belong to the superseded callback attempt, 9/10 to the completed confirmation. Native Invoice 298 / INV-DJY67K and Quotation 40 / QUO-DP3RO0 preserve the current text-loss reproduction; earlier draft 297 is retained as attempt history. Their owned stockless catalogue products are archived.

Owned customer contacts created for credit/search/stale-selection controls are retained inactive. Synthetic QA cash sales, credits/debits, purchase orders and adjustment audit records are retained for traceability. These are test records, not deleted financial history.

Native JSON export job 1 and its QA-only output were retained locally for validation; the raw export dump is excluded from the portable developer evidence package. No production restore, external payment, customer email/SMS or webhook dispatch was requested.
Only automation-owned sessions were revoked/logged out; existing owner sessions and authentication factors were preserved.
